global: Daybreak v7: Shrines are a new mini-objective (spawn 2:00, respawn 4:00, 3,100 HP) granting +2 permanent ability haste, 50 global gold, and up to two stacks of +8% true damage to towers.
Teleporters unlock at game start (was 8:00) with shorter cooldowns (120s early / 90s late) — cross-map pressure starts immediately.
Tower platings never expire (was 13:00), Tier 2 towers gain 4 platings of their own, and Tier 2 local gold falls 400 -> 250 — plating gold is the new tower economy.

Jungle economy rework: camp gold up across the board (Red/Blue 125 -> 165, large camps ~+40%), out-of-combat regen doubled (no more chip-clearing), CS values rebalanced, and duo/off lanes each gain a second Gold/Cyan buff at roughly half value.
Recall 8s -> 7s, DoTs no longer interrupt recalls, death timers ramp later (30:00), fountain no longer one-shots divers (ticking true damage instead).

eternals.summary: Four new Eternals join (Weald, Rust, Pilow, Satatriel), Cauterize is deleted for Mechadrive, Marrow is reworked to missing-health lifesteal, and the sustain/economy minors all take a trim.

changes.name: Weald
changes.change: NEW — major fires true-damage projectiles at enemies below 30% health.
changes.meaning: An execute Eternal: finishes low targets through armor. Expect it on burst divers and anyone who struggles to close kills.

changes.name: Rust
changes.change: NEW — major applies stacking armor shred that amplifies damage taken.
changes.meaning: A team-amplifier for sustained hitters: the longer a target is worked, the softer it gets for everyone.

changes.name: Pilow
changes.change: NEW — major pulses a debuff reducing enemy damage output.
changes.meaning: A defensive team Eternal — front-liners and supports can now itemize enemy damage down instead of only their own health up.

changes.name: Satatriel
changes.change: NEW — major grants stacking power from takedowns while reducing max health.
changes.meaning: A snowball gamble: every takedown makes the carrier hit harder and die easier. Strong ahead, throwing fuel behind.

changes.name: Mechadrive
changes.change: NEW (replaces Cauterize) — basic attacks refund 10% of the Secondary ability cooldown on-hit (5% vs non-heroes).
changes.meaning: An attack-weaving reward for hybrid kits; Cauterize owners need a new pick.

changes.name: Marrow
changes.change: Reworked: heal 6-9% of hero damage, scaling up to 15-30% based on missing health (65% for AoE, 15% vs monsters).
changes.meaning: Lifesteal that arrives when low instead of always-on — stronger in losing fights, weaker for stat-checking at full HP.

changes.name: Roses
changes.change: Bonus takedown gold capped at +100g (5 takedowns); hero kills grant +50% of Marrow major for 8s.
changes.meaning: The gold engine gets a ceiling but adds a post-kill sustain window.

changes.name: Ferocity
changes.meaning: A straight trim to the attack-speed minor most carries defaulted to.

changes.name: The King
changes.meaning: Slightly slower gold curve for on-hit builds.

changes.name: Nihil
changes.change: Stat effectiveness per takedown or level 18% -> 20%.
changes.meaning: The scaling minor closes more of the gap.

changes.name: Feeding Frenzy
changes.meaning: The cleanup radius shrinks — kills must be closer to feed it.

changes.name: Immaculate
changes.meaning: Second consecutive trim — the defensive window keeps shrinking.

changes.name: Masterpiece
changes.meaning: A small shave on the takedown-scaling damage minor.

changes.name: Aion
changes.meaning: The mage economy minor pays a little less, on top of its 1.15.3 power trim.

changes.name: Sacrifice
changes.change: Ability hits grant 2.5% missing-mana regen over 5s; hero kills regenerate 20% missing mana over 5s.
changes.meaning: Mana sustain now flows from aggression instead of passively.

analysis.summary: Kira's Mercy ability was nerfed, notably lower damage.
analysis.playing: Your poke and finishing damage from Mercy is down; rely more on positioning and basics.
analysis.facing: Her burst is lower — you can play a bit more forward against her poke.

changes: Percussive Tear now correctly shreds magical armor (bugfix)
Tesseract attack speed per canister -1% all tiers; non-hero healing 25% -> 20%
Primeval Roar damage reduction top rank 36% -> 30%
Falcon Crunch empowered damage 15% -> 20%, in-air cooldown +30% -> +25%
Make Way now correctly shreds magical armor (bugfix)
Double Pain scaling up to 165% top rank, cooldowns +0.5s

analysis.summary: Big buff: Cull comes back dramatically faster and his kit now scales with Magical Power too, opening strong bruiser/AP jungle builds with far more ult uptime.
analysis.playing: You can fight and re-fight much more often thanks to the shorter Cull cooldown; experiment with Magical Power for extra sustain and damage.
analysis.facing: He'll have his execute ult up almost every skirmish now — avoid repeated low-health duels and bring anti-heal.

changes: Spirit Shred now correctly shreds magical armor (bugfix buff)

analysis.summary: Bugfix: a Contagion cleanse exploit was closed — no intended balance change.
analysis.playing: Play as normal; the cleanse interaction just works correctly now.
analysis.facing: Unchanged matchup outside the patched exploit.

changes: Tiny Titan size modifier -43% -> -33% (bigger hitbox on the shrink augment)
Gravebreaker: Colossal Blow now damages towers (25% max-health true damage)
Axe Retrieval also grants Highland Hurl +15% damage
Severance damage down (-25 top rank) but scaling 105% -> 115%
Soul Weaver ult CDR 8% -> 10%; Ephemeral Surge move speed 35% -> 25%, duration shorter
Physical power 60 -> 57, growth 3.6 -> 3.8 (early flattened, scaling intact)
Tesla Dome now correctly shreds magical armor (bugfix)
Slayer Of The Heavens minion-aggro bugfix
Health regen 1.8 -> 1.55; physical power growth 1.49 -> 1.65; armor 27 -> 29

analysis.summary: Bugfix: Allegro's cooldown refund now behaves correctly — no intended balance change.
analysis.playing: Play as normal; your cooldown refunds are just consistent now.

changes: Spear of Nyr damage 70-190->70-210, scaling 115%->125%, +25% monster damage reduction, added 80% Magical

analysis.summary: Big all-around buff: more Physical Power per level, a faster/longer Evade, a much stronger Spear of Nyr (now with monster damage reduction and Magical scaling), and a bigger ult.
analysis.playing: He's stronger in lane and jungle — your spear pokes harder, you survive camps better, the ult does more, and Magical Power is now an option.
analysis.facing: Expect harder spear poke and a bigger ult; don't trade into his Evade and respect his improved survivability.

changes: Badlands Critter double-damage bugfix (damage down in practice)
Fixed Overseer not amplifying Cryoseism damage

analysis.summary: Serath was nerfed: shorter stun, weaker empowered-mode damage, and lower Heresy burn.
analysis.playing: Your lockdown and burst are down — land Crushing Descent cleanly and don't over-rely on Fury damage.
analysis.facing: Her crowd control and burst are weaker — you have more room to fight back after her engage.

changes: Rising Storm: fixed a stack bug with Eternals

analysis.summary: Nerf: Windburn scales less and is up less often, plus a Rising Storm/Eternals stacking bug was fixed.
analysis.playing: Your Windburn poke is weaker and on a longer cooldown — rely more on positioning and basics.
analysis.facing: His ability poke is down and less frequent; step up between Windburns.

changes: Mana Catalyst no longer restores mana on non-heroes (heroes 10% -> 12%)
Physical power 58 -> 55, growth 3.8 -> 4.0 (early flattened, scaling intact)
Psychic Flare blink cooldown on hit 1s -> 2.5s

analysis.summary: Broad nerf: less health scaling and lower physical-power scaling across Force Push, Windsurge, and his clone ult.
analysis.playing: Your combo and ult clone hit less — itemize for the lost damage and pick engages carefully.
analysis.facing: His burst and clone pressure are weaker; you can trade into him a bit more confidently.

changes: Cascade reworked — no longer applies on-hit effects
